effects.tracing_beam: Use framer-motion to create a subtle moving border on the main 'Demo Generation' card to indicate AI processing.
effects.glass_header: Use glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50) for the sticky nav.

general: No Inter or generic fonts for headings. Use Outfit.
Do not center-align everything. Use asymmetry.
All containers with borders must have generous padding (p-6 or p-8).
Avoid 'SaaS Blue' defaults. Stick to the Indigo/Slate strict palette.
accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards.
All interactive elements must have focus states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/20.
MUST add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, links, and key metric cards.
motion: Use smooth fade-up animations for page loads.
Add micro-interactions to dashboard widgets (slight lift and shadow on hover).

images.description: Abstract diagonal streaks of blue/purple to use as a subtle, low-opacity background behind the hero section.
Computer-generated AI concept image for the features section.
Professional smiling man avatar to use alongside the 'Welcome Sai!' message.
Female professional avatar for admin or alternate user profiles.

specific_instructions.landing_page: Use the hero_background image with a heavy white gradient overlay (e.g. bg-white/90) so the abstract blue streaks subtly peek through. The hero text should be bold Outfit H1. Add a 'Try the Demo' CTA.
specific_instructions.dashboard: Create a 'Control Room' bento grid. Incorporate a personalized header 'Welcome Sai!' with the avatar_user image. Display stats cards (e.g., 'Generations This Week', 'API Calls'). Include a service-related quote in an empty state or sidebar: 'Translating data into discovery, one triple at a time.'
specific_instructions.kg_generation_panel: Split view: Left side is a textarea using the 'textarea_mono' style for KG Triples. Right side is an output card for the generated natural language. Add a 'Generate' button with the 'primary' button style. Use a skeleton loader with a subtle indigo pulse during generation.
specific_instructions.testing: Ensure all interactive elements have valid data-testid attributes.
